title: ADMM-based Bilevel Descent Aggregation Algorithm for Sparse Hyperparameter Selection
summary: It is widely acknowledged that hyperparameter selection plays a critical role in the effectiveness of sparse optimization problems. The bilevel optimization provides a robust framework for addressing this issue, but these existing methods depend heavily on the lower-level singleton (LLS) assumption, which greatly limits their practical applicabilities. To tackle this technical challenge, this paper focus on a particular type of nonsmooth convex sparse optimization problem and presents a new bilevel optimization framework.
